title: Sexual Purity
definition: Sexual Purity is honoring God with the body, desires, thoughts, and relationships according to His holy design.
summary: Sexual Purity is honoring God with the body, desires, thoughts, and relationships according to His holy design.
christFocus: Jesus redeems the whole person, including the body, and gives His people grace and power to flee immorality and walk in holiness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sexual purity is not shame for having a body or desire. Scripture teaches that the body belongs to the Lord and is meant to honor Him.

God’s design for sexuality is holy, covenantal, and good. Sin distorts desire, but Christ redeems people and calls them into holiness.

The Holy Spirit gives power to flee temptation, renew the mind, and live with integrity. Purity is not self-hatred; it is belonging to Christ with the whole self.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people carry sexual shame, secret bondage, or wounds from misuse and abuse. Sexual purity must be taught with truth and tenderness, pointing to Christ’s cleansing grace and restoring power.

This doctrine also challenges a culture that treats desire as lord. Jesus is Lord over the body and heart.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Bring your desires and wounds to Christ without hiding. Flee temptation, seek wise help, practice honesty, and rely on the Holy Spirit to form holiness in thought, body, and relationships.
